Subject: GCP marketplace purchase — initial MAP draft

Megan — thanks again for the time today. Per our conversation I attached a first-pass MAP (MAP_v1.xlsx) that outlines the evaluation milestones, decision owners, and procurement checkpoints we typically see for GCP Marketplace private-offer purchases. High-level asks from our side:

- Confirm whether your procurement team requires a GCP private offer (vs. marketplace invoice flow) — you mentioned a preference but I wanted it captured here.
- Point person for SOW/PO routing and any legal reviewer names.
- Target close date you want to aim for (we suggested 2026-12-15 in the call).

Proposed timeline (draft):
1) Evaluation & PoC (2 weeks) — CloudOps running sample workloads, Redwood provides config and cost estimate.
2) Procurement review (1 week) — Harvest procurement + GCP PO / private-offer setup.
3) Legal review & redlines (1 week)
4) Final sign & billing setup (3 business days)

If you can confirm procurement contact and whether you need a vendor questionnaire filled out, I’ll loop our legal and finance folks in. I’ve cc’d Ben (partner success) to shadow pricing questions.

Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet: milestones & owners)

Best,
